snippet.title: Reap and Rush - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
👻 Out Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116700/Reap_and_Rush/
Reap and Rush is a fast-paced action roguelike inspired by Chinese mythology. Play as an underworld envoy, combine Fate Stones, Yin Spells and the Five Elements and tear through hordes of Yaoguai to restore order to the afterlife.

▬ Assemble Entertainment ▬▬▬▬▬▬
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/assembleteam
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/assembleteam
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/assembleteam/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/assemble-entertainment
Newsletter: https://mailchi.mp/assembleteam/assemble-newsletter
Website: http://www.assembleteam.com/

Assemble Entertainment is an independent publisher based in Germany, best known for indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Decktamer, Paddle Paddle Paddle, Grind Survivors and the Endzone franchise. Since 2016, Assemble has released more than 50 games across different genres, including cozy, horror, strategy and roguelike, and has established itself as a trusted partner for bringing original indie projects to market. #assembleentertainment
